svg.title: The vestibule, eleven at night
svg.desc: The narrow vestibule between two railway cars at night, with two doors, a red emergency handle in a yellow box, four signs, a notice about the brake, and one person standing alone.

g.text: Fourteen things to find. Three of the four signs are about what you must not do.
the step - and it is not level
the red handle in its yellow box
the floor - one and a half metres square
Dev - he checks these every trip
four signs - three of them say must not
the only place on the train you can be alone
the yellow box, and the red handle in it
Nadia - six cars away, in February
a passenger going through to car 7
the safety inspector, with a clipboard
